STAGE 1 — SCOPE AUDIT of the three proposals against the scope contract (behaviour signal + explicit curved operation + one connected pathway + three switches + minimal spec).

Read: the three proposal texts only (no other workspace files needed; the frozen bundle is inlined in the task).

Observations:
- HYPVOLCAP-RQ: behaviour = popularity-adjusted reverse-transition traffic tau_i (E1/E2 of its bundle), geometry = Poincare geodesic-ball volume -> Klein power-diagram bias cosh(rho_k) with curvature -1, both inside the same per-level assignment score s_ik. Behaviour-off (uniform pi_k -> constant bias) and geometry-off (Euclidean partition) both collapse the score to baseline, so the switches are structurally correct. Constants are derived (0.99-quantile sigma_l, rho_max from max||z_i||, Laplace smoothing, T=8 refresh). IN SCOPE, but the curved operation enters the final decision only as a per-code scalar offset, and the ball-volume recursion is evaluated in raw rho up to 8 (cosh/sinh^31 magnitudes) with no log-space safeguard.
- holonomy-path-behaviour-rq: behaviour = prefix-cohort successor displacement v_pi from the training transition matrix (E1/E2), geometry = Lorentz parallel transport composed o->m->a inside the RQ residual recursion at levels >=2 (E12/E13). Euclidean transport is the identity, so the geometry-off arm reproduces baseline exactly -> the geometry switch cannot be inert, which is the strongest possible evidence that the coupling is real. Constants derived (RMS scale, 99th-percentile clip, <5 items fallback). IN SCOPE, strongest on criterion 3.
- GROMPULL-RQ: behaviour = per-item successor set B_i with relative mass q_ij, geometry = Poincare exp_0 distances, Gromov-style fractional geodesic budget (1-q_ij)(rho_i+rho_j) inside the per-level argmin and the chosen-code loss (E14), matched Euclidean control declared (E15/E16). IN SCOPE on paper, but its stated success criterion is a rank-correlation diagnostic and a recall band, not a mechanism-level prediction.

Still open at this stage: which of the three is best grounded in the shared frozen evidence (E6/E7/E8), i.e. where the 0.065 headroom actually is.

STAGE 2 — EVIDENCE GROUNDING: where does the recall headroom sit, and which mechanism is aimed at it?

Read: shared frozen bundle items E6 (width-20 beam survival, 57,439 test rows), E7 (teacher-forced per-position NLL), E8 (first-level K-cluster capacity ceiling), E5 (successor-entropy stratification), E9 (cohort-profile discriminative margin), plus each proposal's own E12/E13.

Observations from E6:
- Best measured arms are resample recall@10 0.06363, l1_only 0.06233, l1_br_euclid 0.06207; target SID inside 20 beams is only 0.0847-0.0884 there, so beam inclusion AND within-beam ranking both bite.
- Gold-prefix survival in the good arms is 1.000 at depth 1, ~0.829 at depth 2, 0.156-0.161 at depth 3 — the loss of the gold path happens at level 2 and level 3, i.e. exactly the levels holonomy-path-behaviour-rq operates on.
- l1_br is the counter-example that decides the ranking: depth 1/2/3 survival is 1.000/1.000/1.000 yet recall@10 is only 0.04671, and its teacher-forced T4 NLL in E7 is 9.03 versus ~0.05-1.2 in the good arms. Prefix CONCENTRATION buys survival and destroys last-token predictability. Any mechanism whose logic pushes items into bigger/more-shared cells therefore inherits that failure mode.
- E7 confirms the headroom: in the 0.062-0.064 arms T2/T3 NLL is still 3.2-4.4 nats, i.e. the residual recursion at levels 2-3 is the weak part.

Observations from E8/E5/E9 bearing on the other two:
- E8: first-level cluster co-sharing falls 0.3106 (K=16) -> 0.0822 (K=256), but E6 shows the small-K/collapsed regime (l1_br) does not convert co-sharing into recall. So HYPVOLCAP's demand-sized cells are a concentration pressure whose measured analogue is the worst arm, not the best.
- E5: successor entropy is extremely stratified (top-1 mass 0.4375 in bin 1 vs 0.0543 in bin 5, 44.3 mean distinct successors in bin 5). This weakens holonomy's per-prefix single anchor for the high-entropy majority (anchor near zero displacement -> m ~ o -> mechanism close to identity on those items), and it weakens GROMPULL's sparse-tail transition budgets.
- E9: cohort-profile positive/negative margin is narrow (0.9291 vs 0.8871); behaviour signal exists but is not strongly discriminative, so a mechanism that leans on pairwise behaviour pulls (GROMPULL) is leaning on a thin signal.

Provisional order: holonomy (aimed at levels 2-3, geometry switch provably live) > HYPVOLCAP (real single-equation coupling, cheap, but concentration risk with direct l1_br/E7 support against it) > GROMPULL (weak signal, collapse risk, largest cost, diagnostic-not-recall criterion).

Open: final ordering and wording of reasons.

STAGE 3 — FINAL RANKING (answer, complete).

RANK: holonomy-path-behaviour-rq | position=1 | reason=It is the only candidate whose curved operation acts exactly at levels 2..L, where the shared bundle E6 shows the gold prefix dies in every competitive arm (survival 1.000 at depth 1 but 0.829 at depth 2 and 0.156-0.161 at depth 3, best recall 0.06363) and where E7 still shows T2/T3 NLL of 3.2-4.4 nats with recall 0.062-0.064; Euclidean transport being the identity makes its geometry switch provably non-inert (criterion 3 satisfied by construction), its constants are derived (RMS scale, 99th-percentile clip, <5-item fallback) so no sweep is needed, and its +6-10% wall clock fits the frozen 3000-epoch envelope. Its exposure is E5: in bins 3-5 (support 6.7-44.3 distinct successors, top-1 mass 0.054-0.162) the prefix-cohort anchor is diffuse, so m ~ o and the rotation is small for a large share of items, and E9's narrow cohort-profile margin (0.9291 vs 0.8871) caps the per-prefix direction quality.
RANK: HYPVOLCAP-RQ | position=2 | reason=Genuinely in scope and cheap: behaviour (popularity-adjusted reverse traffic tau_i) and curvature (Poincare ball volume -> cosh(rho_k) bias) meet in one assignment equation, behaviour-off gives a constant bias and geometry-off gives the Euclidean partition, and every constant is derived, so it survives the no-sweep/no-ablation policy on +6-10% wall clock. It is placed below holonomy because its mechanism is a demand-sized concentration bias, and the measured analogue of prefix concentration in this bundle is the worst arm, not the best: E6 l1_br reaches depth-1/2/3 survival of 1.000/1.000/1.000 with recall@10 only 0.04671, and E7 gives it T4 NLL 9.03 against ~0.05-1.2 in the 0.062-0.064 arms; E8's small-K co-sharing gain (0.3106 at K=16 vs 0.0822 at K=256) demonstrably did not convert into recall. Secondary defect: the ball-volume recursion is evaluated in raw rho up to 8 with no log-space safeguard, and the rich-get-richer loop between pi_k and the assignment has only Laplace smoothing against it.
RANK: GROMPULL-RQ | position=3 | reason=In scope but the weakest case on the frozen evidence: its one-sided hinge pulls an item's candidate partial-code point toward its training successors' points, which is the same prefix-concentration pressure that E6/E7 measure as harmful (l1_br: perfect prefix survival, recall@10 0.04671, T4 NLL 9.03) and that the behaviour-only prefix family already occupies at 0.0525-0.0540; the signal it pulls on is thin (E5: 44.3 distinct successors and top-1 mass 0.054 in the highest-entropy bin; E9: 0.9291 vs 0.8871 positive/negative cohort-profile margin), and E5 also shows the sparse tails where its q_ij budget is undefined at count>=2. It also carries the largest cost of the three (+20-30% Stage-2 wall clock for two quantizer sweeps and ~3.9e5 hyperbolic distances per step), has an explicit sweep-1/sweep-2 inconsistency risk, and states its own falsification as a rank-correlation diagnostic rather than a recall prediction, which a single run cannot settle.

Objection to the round's chosen mechanism (holonomy-path-behaviour-rq): the prefix-cohort successor anchor is a diffuse, near-global-popularity direction for the high-entropy majority of items (E5 bins 3-5), so for a large share of items m ~ o and the composed transport degenerates toward the identity, leaving the holonomy effect concentrated on the low-entropy minority; without any ablation arm the single run can therefore not d

istinguish "coupling is real but small" from "coupling is inert", and the only diagnostic that can carry that distinction is the level-2/3 token flip rate against the behaviour-off forward pass, which must be logged explicitly.
